title: Fresh form fills nothing
details: Add page.wait_for_selector() after category selection in _fill_form(). Currently runs immediately after _select_category() with no wait for DOM. All .count() > 0 checks return 0 so fills are silently skipped.
acceptance_criteria: After category selection, bot waits for first form field to render
Fields are filled with correct values from ad file
Log shows individual field fill confirmations, not just 'Form filled'

title: No file upload input on fresh form
details: Related to B1. Upload input not found because page hasn't loaded. Fix B1 should resolve this - verify upload input appears after proper wait.
acceptance_criteria: File upload input found after form fields are filled
Photos uploaded successfully on fresh form

title: Description selector grabs title textarea
details: Selector '[name="description"], [placeholder*="Describe"], textarea' with .first picks title textarea (index 0 in DOM). Need specific selector for description textarea only: use [name="description"] or nth textarea.
acceptance_criteria: Description goes into the description field, not the title field
Title field contains only the title text
Verified via JS evaluate on Dubizzle form

title: Title doubled on draft resume
details: Playwright .fill() doesn't clear React-controlled inputs - it appends. Clear first with select-all, then fill. Or use page.evaluate to set the value directly and dispatch a React change event.
acceptance_criteria: Title field shows single copy of title text on draft resume
No duplication or truncation

title: No price set notification creates phantom waiter
details: Line 87-90 sends 'No price set' warning with wait=True (default). Bot enters wait_for_reply(), consuming next messages. Add wait=False same pattern as ae659f9 fix for abort/error paths.
acceptance_criteria: 'No price set' notification sent with wait=False
Next message after notification is processed as new command, not consumed as reply

title: PermissionError crashes error handler thread
details: os.replace(tmp, path) fails with WinError 5 (Access Denied) when file locked. Wrap in retry loop with short delay (0.1s, 3 retries). Or use shutil.move with fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Queue file saves succeed even when briefly locked by another process
No PermissionError tracebacks in logs
Error handler thread doesn't crash

title: edit_ad_copy blocks main poll thread
details: edit_ad_copy() runs synchronously on main thread. For claude_cli provider, blocks 30-60s. Run in thread pool: asyncio.to_thread() or threading.Thread with callback.
acceptance_criteria: Bot remains responsive to messages during edit_ad_copy execution
Edit result still applied correctly to ad file

title: Price validation after browser launch
details: Price check is inside dubizzle.py:run() which runs in posting thread. Moves wasted work: AI variation call, dated copy, queue entry all happen before check. Move price validation BEFORE create_dated_copy.
acceptance_criteria: Price check happens before browser launch and dated copy creation
No wasted AI call or file creation for rooms with [SET PRICE]

title: Batch cancel only cancels first room
details: Cancel during batch only stops current room. Remaining rooms proceed independently. Need a cancel flag that post_batch checks before starting each room.
acceptance_criteria: Cancel during batch posting stops ALL remaining rooms
No browser launches for rooms after cancel

title: change_price modifies live files directly
details: find_ad_file() returns type='live' for real-dated files. Handler has no dated copy logic for live files. Always create dated copy before mutation regardless of file type.
acceptance_criteria: change_price creates a dated copy before modifying
Original file preserved as backup

title: edit_ad doesn't protect live files
details: Checks if info['type'] == 'template' before creating dated copy. Live files (real-dated) skip this. Change to: always create dated copy if no copy exists today.
acceptance_criteria: Edit creates dated copy before applying AI changes regardless of file type
Original file preserved

title: AI edit adds Room/Villa metadata
details: AI adds **Room:** and **Villa:** metadata lines not in original. Add explicit instruction to prompt: 'Do not add metadata fields (Room, Villa) that are not in the original text.'
acceptance_criteria: AI edit output contains only fields present in original ad
No **Room:** or **Villa:** lines added

title: Room 02 template format permanently corrupted
details: Restore from git history or manually rebuild. Should start with '# Room 02 - ...' heading, not '**Title:**'. Remove injected **Room:**/**Villa:** metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Room 02 template starts with # heading
No **Room:** or **Villa:** metadata lines
Format matches other room templates

title: Dated copies inherit corruption from source
details: Add format validation before creating dated copy. Check source file has expected structure (# heading or **Title:** line). Warn if format is unexpected.
acceptance_criteria: create_dated_copy warns when source format looks wrong
Does not silently propagate corrupted format

title: Timezone bug - dates use UTC not Dubai
details: datetime.now() returns UTC. Use datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Dubai')) for Dubai timezone. Import from zoneinfo (Python 3.9+).
acceptance_criteria: Dated copies use Dubai timezone (UTC+4)
Files created at 11pm Dubai time are dated today, not tomorrow

title: Typos propagated from template to copies
details: Add instruction to AI variation prompt: 'Fix obvious spelling errors in the source text (for example, Beatifull -> Beautiful and dinning -> dining).'
acceptance_criteria: AI variation fixes obvious typos
Dated copies don't carry source typos

title: Body price not updated by change_price
details: Only updates **Price:** header line. Body text with old price ('5,200 AED/month') unchanged. Use regex to find and replace price patterns in body text too.
acceptance_criteria: Both header price and body price text updated
Old price no longer appears anywhere in the file

title: No yyyy-mm-dd templates for 5 rooms
details: Rooms 02, 05, 11, 17, 20 only have real-dated files. Create yyyy-mm-dd_ template files from the best available version of each room's ad.
acceptance_criteria: yyyy-mm-dd_room-XX template exists for rooms 02, 05, 11, 17, 20
find_ad_file returns type='template' for these rooms

title: 21 of 29 ad files have [SET PRICE]
details: Flag rooms with [SET PRICE] in status report. Add warning before posting: 'Room XX has no price set. Set price first.'
acceptance_criteria: Status report shows which rooms have [SET PRICE]
Posting blocked with helpful message for rooms without price

title: Discount/promo text lost in AI edits
details: Add instruction: 'Preserve promotional text, discount language, strikethrough prices, and urgency phrases exactly as they appear.'
acceptance_criteria: AI edit preserves discount/promo text verbatim
Strikethrough prices and urgency phrases intact

title: yes after draft creates duplicate
details: After creating a dated copy, 'yes' resolves against context -> classified as draft again -> creates another copy. Add a debounce: check if a dated copy for this room exists within the last 60 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Saying 'yes' after draft creation does not create duplicate
Second 'yes' within 60s is treated as acknowledgment, not new command

title: Price questions misclassified as status
details: Add price-related patterns to classifier: 'how much is room X', 'what does room X cost', 'room X price' should classify as preview (shows ad with price).
acceptance_criteria: 'how much is room 14' classifies as preview, not status
Bot shows the ad text including price

title: Photo count query fails
details: 'how many photos does room 02 have' classified as status but _gather_context doesn't include photo data. Add photo count to context assembly.
acceptance_criteria: Bot can answer 'how many photos' questions
Photo count from Selected/ folder included in context

title: Feature queries unknown
details: 'which rooms are ensuite' classified as unknown. Add feature/metadata intent or route to LLM response path with rooms.json context.
acceptance_criteria: 'which rooms are ensuite' gets a correct answer
Room metadata from rooms.json included in LLM context

title: Comparison queries unknown
details: 'compare rooms 01 and 02' classified as unknown. Add to LLM response path with multi-room context.
acceptance_criteria: 'compare rooms 01 and 02' returns useful comparison
Both rooms' ad data included in LLM context

title: Villa-scoped queries unknown
details: 'show me villa 62 rooms' classified as unknown. Route to LLM response path with villa-filtered room data.
acceptance_criteria: 'show me villa 62 rooms' returns list of rooms in villa 62
Room data filtered by villa number

title: Room number validation missing
details: Room 99 accepted by classifier with no range check. Validate room number against rooms.json before proceeding.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid room numbers rejected with helpful message
Valid range determined from rooms.json, not hardcoded

title: Bare post infers room from context
details: Bare 'post' is classified as post_room with a room inferred from conversation memory. Risky - it could post the wrong room. Require an explicit room for post intent.
acceptance_criteria: 'post' without room number asks which room to post
No silent room inference for posting commands

title: No undo/revert functionality
details: 'undo the last edit' classified as edit with action: undo. Add stub handler that explains: 'Previous versions are saved as dated copies. Check adverts/ folder.'
acceptance_criteria: 'undo' gets a helpful response about dated copies
Not classified as unknown or sent to AI edit

title: No delete draft functionality
details: 'delete the draft for room 02' classified as unknown. Add stub handler explaining current limitations.
acceptance_criteria: 'delete draft' gets a helpful response
Not classified as unknown

title: Photo count not in LLM context
details: _gather_context() doesn't include photo folder info. Add len(am.get_photos(room)) and photo folder path.
acceptance_criteria: LLM context includes photo count per room
Bot can answer photo-related questions

title: _gather_context only includes named rooms
details: When intent has no rooms, context only includes queue status. For 'all rooms' queries, include summary of all rooms from rooms.json.
acceptance_criteria: Queries about all rooms get data about all rooms
'what rooms have no price set' finds all 21 rooms

title: edit room 02 with no instruction
details: 'edit room 02' passes raw text as edit instruction. Validate that instruction contains actual edit guidance. If not, ask: 'What would you like to change?'
acceptance_criteria: 'edit room 02' with no instruction asks for clarification
Does not call AI with empty/vague instruction

title: change price inherits stale room from context
details: 'change price' with no room or amount inherits stale room from conversation. Require room and amount for change_price intent.
acceptance_criteria: 'change price' without room asks which room
'change price' without amount asks what price

title: show all prices needs escalation
details: Haiku can't classify 'show me all the prices' and escalates to Sonnet. Add 'all prices'/'price list' to the regex fast path as a status intent, or improve the Haiku prompt.
acceptance_criteria: 'show me all the prices' classified without escalation
Response includes prices for all rooms

title: Messages eaten during concurrent posting
details: Active wait_for_reply consumes ALL messages as checkpoint replies. Need message queue: if message doesn't look like a checkpoint reply (not yes/no/cancel/revision), queue it for processing after posting completes.
acceptance_criteria: Non-checkpoint messages during posting are queued, not consumed
Queued messages processed after posting flow ends

title: asyncio Task destroyed but pending errors
details: Batch cancel leaves pending approval poll tasks. Properly cancel/await all tasks on batch cancel.
acceptance_criteria: No 'Task destroyed but pending' errors on batch cancel
All async tasks properly cleaned up

title: Queue allows re-queuing rooms in posting status
details: Room in 'posting' status can be re-queued. Block with: 'Room XX is currently being posted. Wait for it to finish or cancel first.'
acceptance_criteria: Cannot re-queue room already in 'posting' status
Clear error message explaining current status

title: edit room with no instruction sends vague prompt
details: Related to B33. Validate the edit instruction before calling AI so the handler asks for clarification instead of sending a vague prompt.
acceptance_criteria: 'edit room 02' with no instruction asks for clarification
Does not call AI with empty or vague instruction text

title: Price formatting inconsistent
details: change_price writes '5200' (no comma). Templates have '5,200'. Normalize to comma-separated format.
acceptance_criteria: Prices always written with comma separation (5,200 not 5200)
Consistent across all operations

title: AI variation exceeds 10-20% promise
details: Titles getting completely rewritten instead of 10-20% variation. Tighten prompt: 'Change at most 2-3 words in the title. Keep the structure, room description, and key selling points identical.'
acceptance_criteria: AI variation changes at most 2-3 words in title
Body structure preserved, only intro paragraph varies

title: Room 17 title style inconsistent
details: Room 17 title 'Very nice and Affordable furnished bedroom' is more casual than the other room templates. Rewrite it to match the existing formal style.
acceptance_criteria: Room 17 title matches formal style of other room templates

title: Room 20 title has discount price suffix
details: Title ends with 'discount price!' which is inconsistent with the other rooms. Remove the suffix and keep the discount information in the body only.
acceptance_criteria: Room 20 title clean, no 'discount price!' suffix

title: Room 05 template typo Beatifull
details: Fix 'Beatifull' -> 'Beautiful' in the room 05 template. Also fix 'dinning' -> 'dining' in the body.
acceptance_criteria: No spelling errors in room 05 template

title: Posting aborted raw error shown to user
details: 'Posting aborted: No price set' is technical. Change to: 'Room XX doesn't have a price set yet. Use "change room XX price to XXXX" to set it, then try posting again.'
acceptance_criteria: User-friendly error message with guidance
Mentions which room and how to fix

title: Draft detection fails on untitled drafts
details: After clearing form, draft becomes 'Untitled Draft'. Bot searches by title match, doesn't find it. Add fallback: check for any draft in the Rooms category.
acceptance_criteria: Untitled drafts detected
Bot asks about existing draft before creating new form

title: Room 14 dated copy created with SET PRICE
details: AI variation preserved [SET PRICE] placeholder. Add check: if price is [SET PRICE], warn and skip variation or flag.
acceptance_criteria: create_dated_copy warns when price is [SET PRICE]
Dated copy not created silently with placeholder price

title: Queue entries stuck in stale status
details: Rooms stay in 'failed' or 'posting' indefinitely. Add staleness check: if posting > 30 min, mark as failed. Surface in status report.
acceptance_criteria: Stale 'posting' entries auto-marked failed after timeout
Status report flags stale entries

title: All rooms query finds only 1 of 21
details: Related to B32. LLM context is too narrow for 'all rooms' queries. Include all room data instead of the single-room subset.
acceptance_criteria: Queries about all rooms get data about all rooms
'what rooms have no price set' finds all matching rooms

title: Multiple checkpoint replies - first dropped
details: When 2 messages arrive during active waiter, first is overwritten by second. Queue checkpoint replies instead of overwriting.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple rapid messages during checkpoint are queued
First message not lost
